correctness.rationale: The simplex/acyclic-arrow correspondence, complete-source shellability, orbit signs and signed Hopf trace are reconstructed. A row-expanded Laplacian determinant counts equivariant acyclic partial maps; fixed block determinant is (-1)^f f^2 by the tree cofactor identity; nonfixed Dirichlet block has unique parent arborescence and determinant (-1)^b; an edge inversion gives determinant zero. These imply the stated rational character and identity multiplicity. Standalone exact checks on 24 unlabeled trees, 967 automorphisms, and mod-2 homology for four small types agree. Infinite claim rests on the proof, not on finite checks.

value.rationale: For the canonical graph cone over every finite tree (no bound on order, valency or symmetry), the theorem classifies the complete rational automorphism representation of Morse-complex top homology by a closed fixed-point/sign character. Such equivariant data is invisible to dimension n^2 and has natural use in symmetry-aware topological computations; it is neither an arbitrary slice nor a reformulation of only the older nonequivariant shellability theorem.
